about_the_game:
Chloe's adventure story!

"Astra Village" is a game about an innocent girl, Chloe, reviving a ruined village and inn.

Chloe explores the area around the village, harvesting and making necessary supplies through farming, manufacturing, and helping the villagers and uncovering the hidden secrets of the village in the process.

adventure and story

If you venture around the village, you can find various environments and monsters

Explore various places to find hidden secrets and valuable items!

farm and management

A lot of things are needed to rebuild villages and inns

Farm and gather ingredients to repair inns and villages and run inns! 

Production

The inn has wonderful fabrication tools to help rebuild the village!

In Astra Village, if you put everything you want in an anvil and build it, you'll see different tools and weapons! Maybe?
